intro: This critical stage of the investigation sees the People's Militia make a breakthrough with the help of a turncoat rogue. In exchange for protection, the Defias Traitor agrees to guide Alliance champions directly to the Brotherhood's hidden base of operations. The journey cuts straight through the occupied ghost town of Moonbrook to uncover Edwin VanCleef's inner sanctum.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So Stoutmantle sends a scrawny traveler like you to protect me? Guess you'll have to do. Better bring some friends too.

You know the deal, right? You watch my back and I'll take you to the Defias hideout. But you better be close by my side. The Defias gang wants my head now. If they see me with you, they'll try to kill me.
Let me know when you and any friends you can round up are ready to go.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What business do you have with me? I am a very busy man...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Most excellent, friend! VanCleef is as good as ours now that we know where he is hiding.
